_about: Photos for the ride sheets and booklet (ride-sheets/build.py). Each ride's photo is the featured image of its ride page on the Bike On website, found by the same slug or name. "pages" names the website page where a ride's name is different there. To use a different photo for a ride, add it to "photos": the ride's slug (as in config/routes.json) and an image web address, or a path in this repo such as "site/assets/photo.jpg". Take a line out to go back to the website photo. A ride with no photo shows a placeholder and is listed in the booklet manifest.
